title: Continuity Assumption
governance_note: Smooth mathematical output does not prove smooth system behavior.

title: Threshold Check
governance_note: A model without threshold review may understate fragility.

title: Equilibrium Review
governance_note: An equilibrium is a mathematical condition, not a complete interpretation.

title: Solver Diagnostic
governance_note: A successful solver run does not prove model validity.

title: Claim Boundary
governance_note: Continuous model claims must be tied to scope, evidence, and diagnostics.
